questions.question: A train is travelling at the speed of 36 km/hr. How much time will the train take to cover a distance of 7/10 of a kilometer?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 36 km/hr

Distance to be covered = 7/10 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

First, convert the speed to meters per second because the distance is in kilometers and we want the time in seconds.

Speed = 36 km/hr

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

⇒ Speed = 36 × 5/18 m/s

⇒ Speed = 10 m/s

Distance = 7/10 km = 700 meters

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 700 / 10

⇒ Time = 70 seconds

**The train will take 70 seconds to cover a distance of 7/10 of a kilometer.**

questions.question: If the number 3823P8 is divisible by 11, then what is the value of P?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 3823P8

Divisible by 11

**Formula used:**

Rule of 11: (Sum of digits at odd positions) - (Sum of digits at even positions) ≡ 0 (mod 11)

**Calculation:**

Digits: 3, 8, 2, 3, P, 8

Odd positions (1st, 3rd, 5th): 3, 2, P → Sum = 3 + 2 + P = 5 + P

Even positions (2nd, 4th, 6th): 8, 3, 8 → Sum = 8 + 3 + 8 = 19

⇒ (5 + P) - 19 ≡ 0 (mod 11)

⇒ P - 14 ≡ 0 (mod 11)

⇒ P ≡ 14 (mod 11)

⇒ P = 14 - 11 = 3

**∴ Value of P = 3**

questions.question: If the number of diagonals in a regular polygon is 9, then what is the sum of all the interior angles of the polygon?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of diagonals = 9

**Formula used:**

Number of diagonals = n(n - 3) / 2

Sum of interior angles = (n - 2) × 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ n(n - 3)/2 = 9

⇒ n(n - 3) = 18

⇒ n² - 3n - 18 = 0

⇒ (n - 6)(n + 3) = 0

⇒ n = 6 (since n > 0)

Sum of interior angles = (6 - 2) × 180 = 4 × 180 = 720°

**∴ Sum of all interior angles = 720°**
